title: Shalmaneser III defeats Hazael
summary: In his eighteenth year Shalmaneser III defeats the army of Hazael of Damascus.
description: In his eighteenth year Shalmaneser III defeats the army of Hazael of Damascus. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 1 “Claimed Assyrian Synchronisms”, row 841 (Nimrud annals, defeat of Hazael, year 18), p. 37; section “Akkadian Lacks the Pluperfect Tense”, p. 7).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 841 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 1 “Claimed Assyrian Synchronisms”, row 841 (Nimrud annals, defeat of Hazael, year 18), p. 37; section “Akkadian Lacks the Pluperfect Tense”, p. 7
chronologies.note: CFAH identification: near the end of Hazael’s reign, not its start. The annal’s “Hazael … seized the throne” is read as backstory.
